title: Nebula Strike
description: Blast through asteroid fields, alien fighters and hunting predators, chain combos for huge scores, grab boosters, and take down a boss every fifth wave.
controls: Move the mouse, or use WASD or the arrow keys, to fly. Your guns fire automatically
Space, B or right click to drop a bomb that clears the screen
On touch screens, drag anywhere to fly and tap the BOMB button
Fly into boosters: P power, S shield, R rapid fire, M missiles, B bomb, U magnet, x2 double points, heart extra life
Kill quickly to build a combo multiplier, and collect gems for bonus points
P or Esc to pause, M to mute
